categories.main_business_segments: W-SCOPE Corporation operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of separators for lithium-ion secondary batteries. The company and its group companies primarily supply polyolefin microporous membrane separators used in lithium-ion batteries for automotive (EV/HEV), consumer electronics, and energy storage systems (ESS).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology lies in the design and processing of high-performance polyolefin microporous membranes, requiring advanced polymer engineering, film formation, and microporosity control at the micron and nanometer scale. Production emphasizes uniform pore distribution, ultra-thin film manufacturing, and high heat resistance, with proprietary know-how in achieving safety features such as shutdown characteristics during abnormal heating.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major lithium-ion battery manufacturers, with Samsung SDI Group accounting for over 87% of sales. The main end markets are automotive (especially EVs), consumer electronics, and industrial energy storage, with a recent strategic push into ion exchange membranes for water treatment and green hydrogen applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are global, with manufacturing concentrated in South Korea and sales spanning Asia (notably Korea and China), Europe (especially Hungary), and the United States. In FY2025, 99.7% of sales were overseas, with the largest revenue contributions from Hungary and Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: W-SCOPE operates midstream in the battery supply chain, providing essential separator materials to battery cell manufacturers, who then supply to OEMs in automotive, electronics, and energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include diversifying the customer base, expanding into new applications for membrane technology (such as ion exchange membranes for water treatment and hydrogen), and improving production efficiency to counter price declines. R&D focuses on ultra-thin, high heat-resistant separators, next-generation polymer materials, and automated production systems, with a strong emphasis on ESG and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of separator products to battery manufacturers, with additional income from new membrane products for industrial and environmental applications. Sales are typically based on direct supply contracts, with some business conducted through agents or on a prepayment basis in certain markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large, established separator manufacturers, many of which have greater financial and technological resources. W-SCOPE is considered a later entrant and is positioned as a specialized, innovative supplier, but faces intense competition from larger rivals with broader customer bases and more diversified product lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated sales were 31,047 million yen, down 35% year-on-year due to EV market slowdown and the deconsolidation of a major subsidiary. The company posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of 3,713 million yen and an operating loss of 1,008 million yen. The company has experienced significant volatility in recent years, with rapid growth until FY2023 followed by contraction and restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: W-SCOPE emphasizes high-quality, high-safety separators with advanced shutdown features, ultra-thin and heat-resistant designs, and the ability to customize for demanding automotive and industrial applications. The company also differentiates through its membrane technology platform, enabling entry into new markets such as ion exchange membranes for green hydrogen and water treatment, and by promoting ESG and sustainability as core values.
